```{r, warning=F, message=F}


library(limma)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)






# 8.1. Import data


# Set file paths
data_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/data"
results_dir <- "C:/Users/peter/OneDrive/Documents/UCSF/BREATH2.Prot/results"

# Import data
metadata_df_with_folds <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "patient_info_with_folds.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F
)

protein_mat <- read.csv(
  file.path(data_dir, "protein_mat.csv"),
  stringsAsFactors=F,
  check.names=F,
  row.names=1
)

# Align metadata and protein matrix
metadata_df_with_folds <- metadata_df_with_folds %>%
  filter(patient_id %in% rownames(protein_mat)) %>%
  column_to_rownames("patient_id")

protein_mat <- protein_mat[rownames(metadata_df_with_folds), ]






# 8.2. Limma DA


# Define LRTI adjudication
metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$LRTI_adjudication,
  levels = c("No Evidence", "Definite")
)

metadata_df_with_folds$sex <- factor(
  metadata_df_with_folds$sex
)

metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years <- as.numeric(
  metadata_df_with_folds$age_in_years
)

# Create design matrix
design <- model.matrix(
  ~ LRTI_adjudication + age_in_years + sex,
  data = metadata_df_with_folds
)

# Fit linear model
fit <- lmFit(
  t(protein_mat),
  design
)

fit <- eBayes(fit)

# Extract differential abundance results
res_df <- topTable(
  fit,
  coef = "LRTI_adjudicationDefinite",
  number = Inf,
  sort.by = "P"
) %>%
  rownames_to_column("gene") %>%
  mutate(
    padj = adj.P.Val,
    log2FoldChange = logFC,
    negLog10P = -log10(padj + 1e-300),
    sig = padj < 0.05,
    direction = case_when(
      sig & log2FoldChange > 0 ~ "LRTI",
      sig & log2FoldChange < 0 ~ "Control",
      TRUE ~ "NotSignificant"
    )
  )






# 8.3. Volcano Plot


# Select proteins to label
label_data <- bind_rows(
  res_df %>%
    filter(direction == "LRTI") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10),
  res_df %>%
    filter(direction == "Control") %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FoldChange)), padj) %>%
    slice_head(n = 10)
)

# Volcano plot
volcano_plot_prot <- ggplot(
  res_df,
  aes(
    x = log2FoldChange,
    y = negLog10P
  )
) +

  # Points
  geom_point(
    aes(color = direction),
    alpha = 0.75,
    size = 2
  ) +

  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(
      "LRTI" = "#D55E00",
      "Control" = "#8B4789",
      "NotSignificant" = "grey85"
    ),
    guide = "none"
  ) +

  # FDR threshold
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = -log10(0.05),
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 0.6,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +

  # Fold-change reference lines
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(-1, 1),
    linetype = "dotted",
    colour = "grey70",
    linewidth = 0.4
  ) +

  # Protein labels
  geom_text_repel(
    data = label_data,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 14 / 2.845,
    fontface = "plain",
    max.overlaps = Inf,
    box.padding = 0.7,
    point.padding = 0.5,
    segment.color = "grey60",
    segment.size = 0.3
  ) +

  # DA protein count
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0,
    y = 4.75,
    label = paste0(
      format(sum(res_df$sig), big.mark = ","),
      " DA proteins"
    ),
    size = 16 / 2.845,
    family = "Arial",
    colour = "black"
  ) +

  # Direction arrows and labels below x-axis via caption
  labs(
    x = expression(log[2]*" fold change"),
    y = expression(-log[10](P[adj])),
    title = "Proteomic differential abundance",
    caption = paste0(
    "\u2190 Downregulated in LRTI",
    "        ",
    "Upregulated in LRTI \u2192"
  )
    ) +

  # x-axis: 1 decimal place
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1)
  ) +

  # y-axis: 1.0 to 5.0 with 1 decimal place
  scale_y_continuous(
    breaks = seq(0, 5, by = 1),
    labels = scales::number_format(accuracy = 0.1),
    limits = c(0, 5.2),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.02, 0.05))
  ) +

  # Theme
  theme_classic(
    base_size = 16,
    base_family = "Arial"
  ) +

  theme(
    text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 16,
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 16,
      colour = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.text = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 16,
      colour = "black",
      face = "plain"
    ),
    axis.line = element_line(
      colour = "black",
      linewidth = 0.5
    ),
    plot.title = element_text(
      family = "Arial",
      size = 16,
      face = "plain",
      colour = "black",
      hjust = 0.5
    ),
    plot.caption = element_text(
      hjust = 0.5,
      size = 16,
      color = "black",
      family = "Arial"
    ),
    plot.margin = ggplot2::margin(10, 15, 10, 10)
  )

print(volcano_plot_prot)

# Save results
write.csv(
  res_df,
  file.path(results_dir, "DA_results_proteomics.csv"),
  row.names = F
)

# Save editable vector PDF
ggsave(
  file.path(results_dir, "volcano_proteome.pdf"),
  volcano_plot_prot,
  width = 6.5,
  height = 6.5,
  device = cairo_pdf,
  bg = "white"
)

# Save plot object for patchwork
saveRDS(
  volcano_plot_prot,
  file.path(results_dir, "volcano_proteome.rds")
)






```

Key changes:
1. Font sizes raised to 16 throughout
2. Arrows removed from inside the plot, replaced with caption `\u2190`/`\u2192`
3. `plot.caption` styling added
4. `scale_x_continuous` with `accuracy=0.1` for 1 decimal place on x
5. `scale_y_continuous` fixed from 1.0 to 5.0 with 1 decimal place labels and `limits=c(0, 5.2)`
6. DA protein count label moved to `y=4.8` to stay within bounds
7. Kept your original spacing/formatting style
